settings.heading: Fruit body, water, ethanol, time.
settings.text: The method is older than the brand. The workshop is in Plettenberg Bay.

settings.heading: Dual extraction, small batch
settings.text:
Dried fruit body is extracted in spring water and approximately 30% food-grade ethanol. Water takes the polysaccharides. Ethanol takes the triterpenes and the other alcohol-soluble fraction. One dropper holds both.

We bottle in amber glass so the extract stays itself on the way to you. Each label names the species and the dried-material equivalent per millilitre — the manufacturer's input ratio, not a laboratory potency boast.

settings.heading: Certificates, as they arrive
settings.text: Supplier names, organic certificates, batch lab reports and harvest permits are published on this page as soon as we have them to show you. Until a document is in hand we do not print the word on the bottle page.
